blocks.text: Websters Corners homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Websters Corners, September 2026. Detached houses: 8 listed at month end and 2 sold in September, a sales ratio of 25%. No condos and townhomes were listed or sold in Websters Corners between June and September.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 8 sold over 4 months against an average of 11.2 listed, about 5.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 4 sold.

faq.q: What and where is Websters Corners?
faq.a: Websters Corners (the City spells it Webster's Corners) is a rural acreage community at the east edge of the City of Maple Ridge, near the Mission border just off Dewdney Trunk Road — it is both a City neighbourhood name and the board/Paragon sub-area name, and the City notes its BCIT Woodlot mountain-bike trails and film-production activity.

faq.q: How did Websters Corners sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached recorded 8 active listings, 2 solds and a 25% sales ratio — the highest detached sales ratio of any Maple Ridge sub-area that month, on a very small base — while Condos & Townhomes recorded 0 listings and 0 solds, as published (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

Webster's Corners Elementary (25554 Dewdney Trunk Road), Blue Mountain Elementary (12453 248 Street, per the BC Ministry K-12 file) and Garibaldi Secondary (24789 Dewdney Trunk Road) are physically in the area; for the sample address 25554 Dewdney Trunk Road the SD42 locator gives Webster's Corners Elementary and Garibaldi Secondary — check any other address in the locator.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Websters Corners?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 8 houses listed with 2 sold in the month in Websters Corners. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Websters Corners a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 25% on too few listings to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
